messages:
Ivan: hi all — first day! I don’t see the Okta app for the GitHub org, no shared drive folder, and 1Password says I don’t have a seat. my work email is ivan.k@redwood.com :wave:
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Ivan! Account provisioning started. Status snapshot: Okta account created, Google Workspace group sync pending, 1Password seat unassigned. You’ll get invites once group sync finishes.
Priya: welcome @Ivan :tada: pinging @Alex (IT) and @Sam (People Ops) to speed up the final bits
Alex (IT): hey Ivan — can you confirm the exact email you used to sign up? also quick check: open okta.redwood.com and see if you can view the dashboard or it shows "No apps"
Ivan: confirmed — ivan.k@redwood.com. Okta shows "No apps available" when I log in (blank dashboard)
Alex (IT): thanks. sometimes group provisioning lags. I’m going to check the group membership for your user and trigger a manual sync.
Alex (IT): running: `GET /admin/directory/v1/groups?userKey=ivan.k@redwood.com` -> shows no membership in eng or devs groups. Manually adding to "eng" now.
DevOps: FYI 1Password seat assignment ties to the Google Group sync we run every 10m + a downstream queuing job. If Okta/Groups look good but 1Password still missing, ping here and I can force the webhook replay.
Alex (IT): forced a group push and triggered the internal sync job: `POST /internal/syncs/google-groups?force=true&user=ivan.k@redwood.com` — job id 8f3b2
Sam (People Ops): Ivan — I’ll keep an eye on the 1Password invite. sometimes it lands in spam; check for invite@1password.com. If nothing in 30m I’ll assign a seat directly from the admin console.
Ivan: thanks. I can see the GitHub app in Okta now :thumbsup: but Drive still not showing the shared folder link under "Shared drives"
Alex (IT): Drive shared folder is created but permission propagation can take a few minutes. I just added you explicitly to the folder ACL as a fallback. Try refreshing drive.google.com and search for "redwood-engineering"
Ivan: found it! access to the drive. 1Password still shows "No seat" though
DevOps: I replayed the webhook queue for user ivan.k@redwood.com. You should get a 1Password invite shortly.
Sam (People Ops): I also assigned a seat manually — you should receive an invite to your email in the next 2–3 min. Did you check spam?
Ivan: got the 1Password invite — setting up now. thanks everyone, everything seems to be working. :rocket:
Onboarding Bot: All clear: Okta app visible, Drive shared folder access, 1Password seat assigned. Closing provisioning ticket in 1h if no further activity.
Priya: fantastic — welcome aboard Ivan! if you want a quick intro to the codebase later today ping me and we’ll pair for 15m.
Ivan: would love that, thanks :smile:
